description: This file is a PHP class that compiles PHP expression tags within the Smarty templating engine. It handles different PHP tag types, escaping, and parsing of PHP code within templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_Php
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling PHP expressions within Smarty templates, handling various PHP tag types and escaping mechanisms.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles code for generating output from any expression based on attributes such as 'code' and 'type'. Handles different PHP snippet types and escaping based on configuration.

methods.name: parsePhp
methods.description: Lexical parser function to parse PHP code segments, identifying start and end tags, as well as handling embedded comments and scripts.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: A callback for escaping PHP code when using the PHP_QUOTE handling method.
